newsitem.title: THAILAND: FORECAST - KTT revises down Thai growth prediction.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - KTT revises down Thai growth prediction.

text.p: Thai finance and securities firm Krungthai Thanakit Plc has revised its 1997 Thai economic growth forecast down to five percent from 6.25-6.50 percent, the company said on Friday.
"We believe that a rate of around five percent makes sense, although we feel that the risk is still that this number may have to be revised down again," it said in a report.

Official estimates of around seven percent annual growth were unrealistic, it said, because the manufacturing and agricultural sectors, which account for around half of gross domestic product, were growing at only five percent.
In addition, a reduction in growth in the financial sector was also expected, it said.
The firm has also adjusted its estimate for the current account deficit to four percent as a proportion of GDP from the 7.25 percent it previously forecast.
Inflation for the full year in 1997 was likely to be four percent as weak demand continues to put pressure on prices, the firm said. No previous inflation forecast was given.
